title: Record the boundary half-bandwidth after interior removal
body:
## Summary
- A piece longer than `4w` keeps its first `w` and last `w` rows, and the Schur fill between those groups has boundary rank separation `2w-1`.
- All 196,605 compositions with width 1 to 3 and length at most 16 stay within that separation, and each width attains it.
- A single piece of length `4w+1` attains `2w-1` for every width from 1 through 40. The published allowance of `2w` covers it. The selected κ is unchanged.
